The head of the house had ridden out three days' journey to meet King Henry at the boundary of his estate, and the King had ridden back with him to lie in the tall State bed in the castle guest-chamber....
realReadableEnd: s one of these moments that are as short as a watch-tick, and as long as a year. She stood there and asked herself, "Have I dreamed it all?
